projects.name: Live Event Radar
projects.description: Real-time venue dashboard for brand activations. Reusable components and shared Zustand state; stock events follow one validated path into synchronized command center and telemetry map views. Responsive layout, keyboard-accessible SVG zones, Leaflet map (client-side). Feature-sliced architecture, VitePress docs, 24 Vitest tests, Playwright smoke tests, GitHub Actions CI.

projects.name: ReconFlow
projects.description: Headless FastAPI reconciliation pipeline with separate ingest, transform, and match stages. Bank CSVs and invoice data flow through dbt into a reconciliation mart and exceptions queue. REST API and CLI only. Python, FastAPI, dbt, PostgreSQL, Dagster (in progress).
